page.layout: One page of text, centred. Heading "Errata Typographica" with its subtitle, then a table of page and line numbers with corrections, then an italic closing line. No running head or page number. A strip of the neighbouring page's margin at the left edge is not transcribed.
page.notes: The left strip shows fragments of the neighbouring page's margin notes (e.g. "us s arte", "Penates", "cerebrum", "Basil"); these belong to another page and are left out. The first letter of the closing line is a decorative swash capital, read as C. The numbers in the page column are italic. The line "emendation.lib.1." is as printed; the final numeral is small and may be a 1 or an i.
